海外姊妹校列表資訊(代)

📢 2026/9/18 交換生申請說明會簡報檔已開放下載囉～[2027秋2028春出國交換申請說明簡報] 

名額至選填志願開始後就會確定(排除姊妹校有臨時調整或凍結之不可控因素)

請同學確實查詢姊妹校網頁，若與校方網頁有出入，請先以姊妹校資訊為參考依據。
因校內申請時程為提前一學年作業，姊妹校若有任何申請條件上之調整，一律以姊妹校標準為依據，建議同學語言檢定取得一定之分數，俾利符合姊妹校之要求。
 
【2027秋／2028春】可交換名額說明

2027秋／2028春可交換名額，請參考「海外交換計畫學校一覽表（2027秋／2028春）」以及下列表單：

表單欄位說明 :

📌 春／秋／一學年共用名額 :

若顯示為 3，代表該校共有 3個交換名額。

原則上，不論選擇：

  • 2027秋季一學期
  • 2028春季一學期
  • 一整學年

每位學生皆會使用 1個交換名額。

⚠️ 請注意：共用名額3名，並非「秋季3名＋春季3名＋一學年3名」，而是三種交換期間合計共用3個名額。

請務必同時確認「說明欄」之交換期間限制：

  • 若註明「限申請1整學年」→ 共用名額僅限申請 一整學年。
  • 若註明「限申請秋季學期或1整學年」→ 僅開放申請 秋季一學期或一整學年。
  • 若「說明欄」未特別註明交換期間限制 → 原則上可申請 秋季一學期、春季一學期或一整學年。

📌 秋季班專用名額 :

若顯示為 3，代表共有 3個名額僅限申請2027秋季班。

不得用於2028春季班或一整學年。

📌 春季班專用名額 :

若顯示為 3，代表共有 3個名額僅限申請2028春季班。

不得用於2027秋季班或一整學年。

⚠️ 請注意 :

若姊妹校於 秋季及春季皆有交換名額，且「說明／備註」欄 未註明僅限交換一學期，則同一位學生可申請：

🍂 秋季學期 ＋ 🌸 春季學期 = 連續交換兩學期（一學年）

如「說明」欄另有交換期間限制，則 以該欄所載規定為準。

 

🔎 選填志願前請務必確認 :

以下列表提供之姊妹校語言要求及相關申請條件僅供參考，實際規定請以 姊妹校官網最新公告 為準（可點選姊妹校列表說明欄連結至相關網站）。

選填志願前，請務必自行確認符合欲申請姊妹校之交換資格, 相關交換資訊請自行至姊妹校官網查詢。

 

⚠️ 若發現下列表單與出國交換生甄選系統所顯示之交換名額有出入，請務必來信或電話與承辦人確認，謝謝。

 

For the 2027 Fall/2028 Spring exchange places, please refer to the following table.
 
Column Descriptions :

📌 [Shared Exchange Places for Spring / Fall / Full Year] :

If the number shown is 3, this means that the partner university has a total of 3 exchange places available.

In principle, students may apply for:

  • One semester in Fall 2027
  • One semester in Spring 2028
  • One full academic year

Each student will use 1 exchange place, regardless of the exchange period selected.

⚠️ Please note: 3 shared places do NOT mean “3 places for Fall + 3 places for Spring + 3 places for a full academic year.” The three exchange periods share a total of 3 places.

Please also check the “Notes” column carefully for any restrictions on the exchange period:

  • If the Notes state “Full academic year only” → the shared places may only be used for a full academic year.
  • If the Notes state “Fall semester or full academic year only” → applications are limited to one semester in Fall or one full academic year.
  • If the Notes do not specify any restrictions on the exchange period → students may, in principle, apply for one semester in Fall, one semester in Spring, or one full academic year.

📌 [Exchange Places for Fall Semester] :

If the number shown is 3, this means that 3 exchange places are available exclusively for Fall 2027.

These places cannot be used for Spring 2028 or a full academic year.

📌 [Exchange Places for Spring Semester] :

If the number shown is 3, this means that 3 exchange places are available exclusively for Spring 2028.

These places cannot be used for Fall 2027 or a full academic year.

 

⚠️ Please Note :
If a partner university has exchange places available for both the Fall and Spring semesters, and the “Description/Remarks” column does not specify that exchange is limited to one semester, a student may apply for:

🍂 Fall Semester + 🌸 Spring Semester = Two Consecutive Semesters (One Full Academic Year)

If the “Description/Remarks” column specifies any restrictions on the exchange period, the restrictions stated in that column shall apply.

 

🔎 Important Information Before Selecting Your Preferences :

The language requirements and other application requirements of partner universities provided in the table below are for reference only. Please refer to the latest information published on the official websites of the partner universities for the actual requirements. Relevant websites can be accessed through the links provided in the “Notes” column of the partner university list.

Before selecting your preferences, please make sure that you meet the eligibility and application requirements of the partner universities you intend to apply to. Students are responsible for checking the relevant exchange information on the official websites of the partner universities.

大洋洲 澳大利亞 墨爾本大學
                        University of Melbourne		 學士班, 碩士班, 博士班 2 -   -

秋季班：9-12月 春季班：3月-6月
https://study.unimelb.edu.au/how-to-apply/international-exchange-and-study-abroad/entry-requirements

  • 學業成績要求： 須符合 Melbourne 最低學業成績要求；一般參考標準約為 GPA 3.0/4.0 或同等成績，實際依原就讀國家及評分制度認定。
  • 英語要求： 若原就讀學校之所有課程均以英語授課及評量，可符合交換／Study Abroad 的英語要求；其他學生須依規定提供 University of Melbourne 接受之英語能力證明。
  • 英語檢定： 接受 IELTS、TOEFL iBT、PTE Academic、Cambridge English 等指定檢定；檢定原則上須於預計入學日前 24 個月內完成。
  • 選課： 可依學生原就讀學位及學術背景選修學士或研究所層級課程；部分課程設有先修條件或學院限制，符合基本入學資格不代表所有課程均可選修。
  • 詳細資訊： University of Melbourne – Exchange and Study Abroad Entry Requirements
  • Fact Sheet：University of Melbourne –Fact Sheet
  • Academic Requirement: Students must meet Melbourne’s minimum academic standard. As a general guide, this is approximately GPA 3.0/4.0 or equivalent, depending on the home country and grading system.
  • English Language Requirement: Students whose home institution teaches and assesses all subjects in English may satisfy the English requirement through their previous study. Otherwise, approved evidence of English proficiency is required.
  • Course Selection: Undergraduate or graduate-level subjects may be taken depending on the student’s home degree and academic background. Individual subjects may have prerequisites or faculty-specific restrictions.
  • Exchange Duration: Exchange students may study at Melbourne for one or two semesters, subject to the applicable exchange agreement with NTHU.
  • More Information: University of Melbourne – Exchange and Study Abroad Entry Requirements
  • Fact Sheet：University of Melbourne – Fact Sheet

亞洲 日本

九州大學

Kyushu University
                       

學士班, 碩士班, 博士班 2 -   -

秋季班：10-2月春季班：4月-8月
https://www.isc.kyushu-u.ac.jp/intlweb/en/admission/exchangetop?utm_source=chatgpt.com

 

  • 申請資格： 申請者於交換開始時須已在母校學位課程修讀至少 1 年，並應申請與目前就讀學位層級相同之課程；申請研究所交換者須具備大學畢業證書或學位證明。
  • GPA 要求： 最低 3.2/4.0。
  • 語言要求：
    • 日語授課課程： JLPT N1 或同等程度。
    • 英語授課課程： TOEFL iBT 79／IELTS 6.0 或同等程度。
    • 英語能力亦可提供九州大學認可之其他同等證明；TOEIC 不接受。
  • 大學部／研究所交換： 可申請九州大學相關 School／Graduate School。大學部學生不得修習研究所層級課程；研究所各研究科可使用日語或英語進行交換，實際課程及研究安排依各研究科規定為準。
  • JTW (Japan in Today’s World)： 主要為大學部學生設計，研究生亦可申請，惟大學部學生於錄取時享有優先；最低 GPA 3.2/4.0，英語須達 TOEFL iBT 79／IELTS 6.0 或同等程度。
  • JLCC (Japanese Language and Culture Courses)： 限母校主修 Japanese Studies（日語／日本研究）之大學部學生申請；最低 GPA 3.2/4.0；原則須具備 JLPT N1，JLPT N2 亦可接受。僅於秋季開始，交換期間為 1 學年（10月–8月）。
  • 詳細資訊： Kyushu University – Exchange Programs
  • Fact Sheet：Kyushu University – Fact Sheet June 2026 
  • Eligibility: Applicants must have completed at least one year of study in a degree programme at their home university by the time of enrolment and should apply for a programme at the same academic level as their current enrolment. An undergraduate diploma or certificate of graduation is required for nomination to a graduate programme.
  • GPA Requirement: Minimum 3.2/4.0.
  • Language Requirement:
    • Japanese-taught courses: JLPT N1 or equivalent.
    • English-taught courses: TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.0 or equivalent.
    • Other equivalent qualifications accepted by Kyushu University may also be submitted as proof of English proficiency. TOEIC is not accepted.
  • Undergraduate / Graduate Exchange: Students may apply to the relevant School or Graduate School at Kyushu University. Undergraduate students are not permitted to enrol in graduate-level courses. Graduate programmes may be conducted in Japanese or English, subject to the requirements and course/research availability of the respective Graduate School.
  • JTW (Japan in Today’s World): Primarily designed for undergraduate students. Postgraduate students may also apply; however, undergraduate students are given priority in admission. Minimum GPA 3.2/4.0; TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.0 or equivalent is required.
  • JLCC (Japanese Language and Culture Courses): Open to undergraduate students majoring in Japanese Studies at their home institution. Minimum GPA 3.2/4.0; JLPT N1 is generally required, although JLPT N2 is acceptable. The programme starts in the fall semester only and runs for one academic year (October–August).
  • More Information:  Kyushu University – Exchange Programs
  • Fact Sheet： Kyushu University – Fact Sheet June 2026

東北大學

Tohoku University
                       

學士班, 碩士班, 博士班 3 -　 -  

秋季班：10-2月春季班：4月-8月
https://www.insc.tohoku.ac.jp/english/exchange/english-requirement-for-exchange-program/?utm_source=chatgpt.com

 

  • 交換計畫：
    • JYPE (Junior Year Program in English)： 限大學部 3、4 年級學生；適用理學、工學及農學領域，以英語授課；可交換秋季 1 學期或自秋季起交換 1 學年。
    • IPLA (International Program in Liberal Arts)： 限大學部 2–4 年級學生；適用人文及社會科學領域。可交換 1 學期或 1 學年；春季入學僅限指定姊妹校學生申請。
    • DEEP (Direct Enrollment Education Program)： 限大學部學生；適用理學、醫學、牙醫、藥學、工學及農學等自然科學相關領域，課程主要以日語授課。
    • COLABS (Cooperative Laboratory Study Program)： 限研究所學生，為以自然科學領域研究為主之研究型交換計畫。
  • 語言要求：
    • JYPE／IPLA／COLABS： TOEFL iBT 79、TOEFL PBT 550、IELTS 6.0、TOEIC 730、CEFR B2 或其他同等英語能力證明。
    • DEEP： JLPT N1 或同等程度。
  • COLABS 特別注意： 申請者須事先取得東北大學預定指導教授之同意。自 2026 秋季起，須依東北大學規定之時程，透過 Prior Consent of Acceptance Request 程序提出申請；申請者不得自行直接聯絡預定指導教授。
  • 詳細資訊：Tohoku University – Exchange Programs
  • Fact Sheet：Tohoku University– Fact Sheet
  • Exchange Programmes:
    • JYPE (Junior Year Program in English): For 3rd- and 4th-year undergraduate students in Science, Engineering, and Agriculture; taught in English. Available for one fall semester or one academic year starting in the fall semester.
    • IPLA (International Program in Liberal Arts): For 2nd- to 4th-year undergraduate students in Humanities and Social Sciences. Available for one semester or one academic year. Spring admission is available only to students from designated partner universities.
    • DEEP (Direct Enrollment Education Program): For undergraduate students in Science, Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, and Agriculture; courses are primarily taught in Japanese.
    • COLABS (Cooperative Laboratory Study Program): A graduate-level, research-oriented programme in the Natural Sciences.
  • Language Requirements:
    • JYPE / IPLA / COLABS: TOEFL iBT 79, TOEFL PBT 550, IELTS 6.0, TOEIC 730, CEFR B2, or equivalent.
    • DEEP: JLPT N1 or equivalent.
  • COLABS: Applicants must obtain prior consent from a prospective academic advisor through Tohoku University's official Prior Consent of Acceptance Request procedure. Applicants must not contact prospective academic advisors directly.
  • More Information: Tohoku University – Exchange Programs
  • Fact Sheet：Tohoku University– Fact Sheet

亞洲 日本

北海道大學

Hokkaido University
                       

學士班, 碩士班, 博士班 2

-

  

-

秋季班：10-2月春季班：4月-8月
https://www.global.hokudai.ac.jp/admissions/short-term-exchange/

  • HUSTEP（Hokkaido University Short-Term Exchange Program）：
    • 限大學部學生申請，且抵達北海道大學前須已完成至少 2年大學課程。
    • 課程主要以英語授課，不要求具備日語能力。
    • GPA：原則為累積 GPA 3.0/4.0以上或同等程度（or equivalent）。 GPA 將於正式申請後，由北海道大學依申請人原就讀大學之成績評分制度（grading policy）進行換算及審查。因此，若原學校採不同 GPA 制度（如本校採4.3制），無法直接以原校 GPA 判定是否等同 3.0/4.0，實際換算及資格認定以北海道大學審查結果為準。
    • 北海道大學另說明，審查並非僅以 GPA 為唯一標準，亦會綜合考量英語能力、推薦信、申請動機（Motivation Letter）等資料；因此，並非只有 GPA 已確認達 3.0/4.0以上者才能提出申請。
    • 非英語母語者須具備 TOEFL iBT 79 或 IELTS 6.5以上；其他國際認可英語檢定（如 CEFR C1以上）亦可能接受，不接受 TOEIC 或 Duolingo。北海道大學並公告，自 2028年1月起採用新版 TOEFL iBT 分數時，最低要求為 4.5。
    • 可交換一學期或一學年
    • HUSTEP 學生有資格申請 JASSO 獎學金，但名額有限，並非所有學生皆可獲得。
  • Special Auditor（Undergraduate）：
    • 限大學部學生，分配至特定學院，與一般學位生共同修習所屬專業領域課程；北海道大學註明，專業科目可提供給大二以上大學生。
    • 須具備良好學業成績，以及相當於 JLPT N2以上之日語能力（preferably native level）。
    • 可交換一學期或一學年
    • 獎學金：N/A。
  • Special Auditor（Graduate）：
    • 限研究生，分配至特定研究所／學院，修習其專業領域課程。
    • 須具備良好學業成績；原則上須具備相當於 JLPT N2以上之日語能力，但實際要求依各研究所而異。
    • 可交換一學期或一學年
    • 獎學金：N/A。
  • Special Research Student（SRS）：
    • 限研究生，分配至特定研究所，以專業領域之研究及接受研究指導為主，而非一般修課型交換。
    • 須具備良好學業成績，以及足以與指導教授溝通之英語或日語能力；實際要求可能依研究所或指導教授而異。
    • 原則上申請前須先聯繫教授，取得願意提供研究指導的非正式同意（unofficial agreement）；部分學院不要求此程序，應依申請時規定確認。
    • 可交換一學期或一學年
    • 不授予學分，SRS 學生僅接受研究指導；獎學金：N/A。
  • 在學身分： Special Auditor 及 SRS 交換期間均須持續以全職學生身分註冊於原就讀大學。
  • 詳細資訊： Hokkaido University – HUSTEP
  • Hokkaido University – Special Auditor / Special Research Student
  • Fact Sheet： Hokkaido University - Fact Sheet 2026-2027 
  • HUSTEP (Hokkaido University Short-Term Exchange Program)
    • Eligibility: Undergraduate students only; applicants must have completed at least two years of undergraduate study prior to arrival.
    • Courses: Mainly taught in English. Japanese proficiency is not required.
    • GPA: A cumulative GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above, or equivalent, is required. If the home university uses a different GPA scale (e.g. NTHU’s 4.3 scale), eligibility will be determined by Hokkaido University based on its assessment.
    • English Requirement: TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.5 or above. Other internationally recognised English qualifications, such as CEFR C1 or above, may also be accepted. TOEIC and Duolingo are not accepted.
    • New TOEFL iBT Scale: From January 2028, the minimum requirement will be 4.5.
    • Exchange Period: One semester or one academic year.
    • Scholarship: Students may apply for the JASSO Scholarship, subject to availability.
  • Special Auditor (Undergraduate)
    • Eligibility: Undergraduate students who wish to take courses in their specialised field. Specialised courses are generally available from the second year onwards.
    • Academic Requirement: Strong academic record.
    • Japanese Requirement: JLPT N2 or equivalent or above; a higher level of Japanese proficiency is recommended.
    • Exchange Period: One semester or one academic year.
  • Special Auditor (Graduate)
    • Eligibility: Graduate students who wish to take courses in their specialised field.
    • Academic Requirement: Strong academic record.
    • Japanese Requirement: In principle, JLPT N2 or equivalent or above. Requirements may vary by Graduate School.
    • Exchange Period: One semester or one academic year.
  • Special Research Student (SRS)
    • Eligibility: Graduate students undertaking research in their specialised field under academic supervision.
    • Academic Requirement: Strong academic record.
    • Language Requirement: Sufficient English or Japanese proficiency to communicate with the academic supervisor. Requirements may vary by Graduate School or supervisor.
    • Prospective Supervisor: Applicants generally need to contact a prospective supervisor and obtain an unofficial agreement before applying; however, this may not be required by some faculties.
    • Credits: No credits are awarded to SRS students.
    • Exchange Period: One semester or one academic year.
  • More Info： Hokkaido University – HUSTEP
  • Hokkaido University – Special Auditor / Special Research Student
  • Fact Sheet： Hokkaido University - Fact Sheet 2026-2027

  • GPA／其他語言要求： 部分申請條件另要求 GPA 3.3 以上及日語課程 JLPT N1，請依欲申請之學院／研究所最新規定確認。
  • 詳細資訊： Kobe University – Exchange Program Eligibility
  • Fact Sheet： Kobe University – Fact Sheet
  • Exchange Period: Fall semester: October–March; Spring semester: April–September.
  • Eligibility: Limited to NTHU students from the College of Engineering, College of Nuclear Science, College of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, and College of Semiconductor Research.
  • Faculty of Engineering (Undergraduate): JLPT N2 or above.
  • Graduate School of Engineering / Graduate School of System Informatics (Master’s & Doctoral): JLPT N2 or above, or TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.0 or above.
  • GPA / Additional Language Requirements: Some programmes may require a minimum GPA of 3.3 and JLPT N1 for Japanese-taught courses. Applicants should check the latest requirements of their intended school/graduate school.
  • More Information: Kobe University – Exchange Program Eligibility
  • Fact Sheet： Kobe University – Fact Sheet

 

 

 

 
亞洲 日本

金澤大學

Kanazawa University
                       

學士班, 碩士班, 博士班 4 -   -

秋季班：10-2月春季班：4月-8月
https://www.kanazawa-u.ac.jp/en/global-network/study/kuep/?utm_source=chatgpt.com

  • 學業要求： 須具優良學業表現（excellent academic performance），原則上成績達母校平均水準以上(above average)。經金澤大學確認，無明確最低 GPA 門檻，由本校依自身標準進行甄選及提名；符合本校交換生甄選資格者，可依本校程序提出申請。
  • JASSO 獎學金： 另有學業成績相關資格要求，並依其他條件綜合評選，符合學業要求不代表一定獲獎。
  • 年級限制： 申請融合科學院、理工學院、醫藥保健學院之大學部學生，交換開始前須已在母校就讀至少 3年（或5學期）。
  • 語言要求：
    • 日語授課課程：JLPT N2以上。
    • 人文社會環境研究科「日本語教育」專業：JLPT N1。
    • 英語授課課程：TOEIC L&R 700 / TOEFL iBT 72（2026年1月起應試者：新制4.0）/ TOEFL PBT 527 / IELTS 5.5 / Cambridge English 160以上。
  • 特定學院／研究所要求： 申請理工學院、醫藥保健學院，以及部分自然科學、醫學相關研究所者，須就讀母校相對應領域之系所，並具備參與專業研究所需之能力與知識。
  • 指導教授事前同意： 申請融合科學院、理工學院、醫藥保健學院或研究所者，須於申請前取得欲申請之指導教授的事前同意（Provisional Acceptance）；申請人文社會學院者則不需要。
  • 其他： 交換結束後須返回母校繼續就讀；交換期間須維持母校正式學生身分。
  • 詳細資訊： Kanazawa University – KUEP
  • Fact Sheet： Kanazawa University – Fact Sheet-2027-2028
  • Academic Requirement: Applicants must demonstrate excellent academic performance, in principle above the average of their home institution. Kanazawa University has confirmed that there is no specific minimum GPA requirement; NTHU may select and nominate students based on its own academic criteria.
  • JASSO Scholarship: Separate academic eligibility requirements apply, and meeting them does not guarantee a scholarship award.
  • Year of Study Requirement: Undergraduate applicants to the College of Transdisciplinary Sciences for Innovation, College of Science and Engineering, or College of Medical, Pharmaceutical and Health Sciences must have been enrolled at their home institution for at least three years (or five semesters) before the program begins.
  • Language Requirements:
    • Japanese-taught courses: JLPT N2 or above.
    • Japanese Language Education in the Graduate School of Human and Socio-Environment Studies: JLPT N1.
    • English-taught courses: TOEIC L&R 700 / TOEFL iBT 72 (4.0 on the new scale for tests taken from January 2026) / TOEFL PBT 527 / IELTS 5.5 / Cambridge English 160 or above.
  • Requirements for Specific Colleges / Graduate Schools: Applicants to the College of Science and Engineering, College of Medical, Pharmaceutical and Health Sciences, and designated natural science and medical graduate schools must be enrolled in a corresponding field at their home institution and possess the ability and knowledge required to participate in specialised research.
  • Prior Approval from an Academic Supervisor: Applicants to the College of Transdisciplinary Sciences for Innovation, College of Science and Engineering, College of Medical, Pharmaceutical and Health Sciences, or a Graduate School must obtain prior approval (Provisional Acceptance) from their prospective academic supervisor before applying. Applicants to the College of Human and Social Sciences are not required to obtain such approval.
  • Other Requirements: Students must return to their home institution to resume their studies after completing the exchange and must maintain their regular student status at their home institution.
  • More Information: Kanazawa University – KUEP
  • Fact Sheet： Kanazawa University – Fact Sheet-2027-2028

  • 英語要求：

Hanyang University		 學士班, 碩士班, 博士班 2 -   -

秋季班: 9-12月 春季班:3-6月

  • 交換校區：Seoul Campus。
  • 課程： 提供一般課程及英語授課課程。交換生可視課程開放情形跨系選課；最新課程通常於開學前約 1 個月公布。
  • 研究生申請： Seoul Campus 原則上不接受交換生進入 Graduate Program。研究生仍可參加交換，但須修讀 Undergraduate Program 課程；與漢陽大學 Graduate School 有直接合作協議者除外。
  • 不開放院系（Seoul Campus）： College of Medicine、College of Technology Innovation、Department of Data Science、Department of Semiconductor Engineering、Hanyang YK Intercollege。School of Nursing 及 Graduate School（所有系所）僅限具系級交換協議者申請。

  • Fact Sheet：Hanyang University – Fact Sheet AY 2026/2027
  • Exchange Campus: Seoul Campus.
  • Courses: Regular and English-taught courses are available. Exchange students may take courses across different departments subject to availability. The most up-to-date course list is generally available approximately one month before the semester begins.
  • Graduate Students: The Seoul Campus generally does not accept exchange students into Graduate Programs. Graduate students may participate in the exchange programme but are required to take undergraduate-level courses. Exceptions apply to universities with direct partnerships with Hanyang University's Graduate Schools.
  • Colleges/Schools Not Available (Seoul Campus): College of Medicine, College of Technology Innovation, Department of Data Science, Department of Semiconductor Engineering, and Hanyang YK Intercollege. School of Nursing and Graduate School (all departments) are available only under a department-level agreement.
  • Language Requirements: Korean: TOPIK Level 3; or English: IELTS 5.5 / TOEIC 785 / TOEFL iBT 72 (new scale 4.0) / TOEFL ITP 543.
  • Course Registration: Courses in the Business School are in particularly high demand and registration is not guaranteed. English-taught courses are limited in the College of Art and Physical Education and the College of Music, while some courses in the College of Education are also restricted.
  • More Information: Hanyang University – Inbound Exchange Program
  • Fact Sheet：Hanyang University – Fact Sheet AY 2026/2027

亞洲 韓國 延世大學
Yonsei University		 學士班, 碩士班, 博士班 2 - -  

秋季班：9-12月 春季班：3月-6月

  • 語言要求： 所有語言檢定成績須於交換學期開始日前 2 年內取得（春季班 3 月 2 日；秋季班 9 月 1 日）。
    • 韓語授課： KLPT 4 級，或由教授／講師出具之韓語能力評估證明。
    • 英語授課： TOEFL CBT 213、TOEFL iBT 79、TOEFL PBT 550、IELTS 6.5，或同等英語能力證明。
  • 選課注意事項： 學生須於開課第一天取得授課教師同意；Computer Science 課程名額有限且競爭激烈，無法保證成功選課。
  • 詳細資訊： Yonsei University – Incoming Exchange Program
  • Fact Sheet：Yonsei University – Fact Sheet
  • Language Proficiency: All language tests must have been taken within two years of the semester start date.
    • Korean-taught Courses: KLPT Level 4 or an assessment report issued by a professor/lecturer.
    • English-taught Courses: TOEFL CBT 213, TOEFL iBT 79, TOEFL PBT 550, IELTS 6.5, or sufficient proof of equivalent English proficiency.
  • Course Registration: Students must obtain permission from the professor on the first day of class. Computer Science courses are highly competitive and have limited availability.
  • More Information: Yonsei University – Incoming Exchange Program
  • Fact Sheet：Yonsei University – Fact Sheet

          

 



                         
亞洲 韓國 首爾大學
Seoul National University (SNU)		 學士班, 碩士班, 博士班 5 -   -

秋季班：9-12月 春季班：3月-6月

  • 建議語言能力（符合以下任一即可）：
    • 英語： TOEFL iBT 88（新制 4.5）或 IELTS 6.0 以上。
    • 韓語： TOPIK 5 級以上。
    • 韓國歷史系、心理學系、統計學系、藥學系須提供韓語能力證明，並達 TOPIK 5 級以上。
  • 科系限制：
    • 商學院： 限原校主修商學或經濟學之學生。
    • 電腦科學與工程系： 大學部申請者須已修至少 15 學分 CSE 相關課程。
    • **醫學院：**不開放交換生。
    • 牙醫學院： 僅開放牙醫相關碩士班學生。
    • MBA： 僅春季班開放，且限原校全日制 MBA 學生。
    • 法學院： 一般大學部交換生不可直接申請大學部法學課程，部分 School of Law 課程得以研究生身分修習。
    • 聲樂系： 限原校主修聲樂之學生。
  • 特定領域： 欲申請 Medicine、Pharmacy、Dentistry、Nursing、Music、Fine Arts、MBA 者，須事先向 SNU 交換計畫承辦人確認是否開放。
  • 詳細資訊： Seoul National University – Exchange Program
  • Fact Sheet：Seoul National University – Fact Sheet
  • Recommended Language Proficiency (either English or Korean):
    • English: TOEFL iBT 88 (new scale: 4.5) or IELTS 6.0 or above.
    • Korean: TOPIK Level 5 or above.
    • Departments of Korean History, Psychology, Statistics, and Pharmacy: Applicants must provide proof of Korean proficiency at TOPIK Level 5 or above.
  • Academic Restrictions:
    • College of Business Administration: Restricted to students currently majoring in Business or Economics at their home university.
    • Department of Computer Science and Engineering: Undergraduate applicants must have completed at least 15 credits of CSE-related courses.
    • College of Medicine: Not open to exchange students.
    • School of Dentistry: Open only to Master’s students in Dentistry or an equivalent programme.
    • MBA: Available in the Spring semester only and restricted to full-time MBA students.
    • College of Law: Not open to undergraduate exchange students; certain School of Law courses may be available under graduate-level enrolment arrangements.
    • Department of Vocal Music: Restricted to students currently majoring in Vocal Music.
  • Special Programme Restrictions: Applicants interested in Medicine, Pharmacy, Dentistry, Nursing, Music, Fine Arts, or MBA must confirm programme availability with the SNU exchange programme coordinator in advance.
  • More Information: Seoul National University – Exchange Program
  • Fact Sheet：Seoul National University – Fact Sheet

 


                        
                      
亞洲 韓國 慶北大學
Kyungpook National University		 學士班, 碩士班, 博士班 4 -   -

秋季班: 9-12月 春季班:3-6月

  • 申請資格： 官方 2026–2027 Fact Sheet 顯示，交換生須為 KNU 姊妹校之在學學生；目前交換生官方網頁主要列大學部交換資格。
  • 交換期間： 春季班 3 月開始；秋季班 9 月開始。
  • 語言要求： 須具備英語或韓語能力，但 KNU 不要求提交 TOEFL、TOEIC、IELTS 或 TOPIK 等語言檢定成績；校方尊重姊妹校之提名及語言能力審核標準。
  • 修課要求： 大學部每學期最多 18 學分（約 6 門課），最低須修 6 學分（2 門課）；研究生之修課上限依 Fact Sheet 規定辦理。
  • 英語授課： 各學院及系所提供多門英語授課課程；秋季班課程通常於 7 月、春季班於 1 月公布。
  • 詳細資訊： KNU – Exchange Student Program
  • 2026–2027 Fact Sheet： KNU Fact Sheet 2026–2027
  • Eligibility: Exchange students must be currently enrolled at a KNU partner institution. The current exchange webpage primarily states eligibility for undergraduate students.
  • Exchange Period: Spring semester begins in March; Fall semester begins in September.
  • Language Requirement: Students must have proficiency in either English or Korean. However, no official language proficiency test result is required; KNU respects its partner universities’ nomination criteria.
  • Course Load: Undergraduate students may take up to 18 credits (approximately 6 courses) per semester, with a minimum of 6 credits (2 courses).
  • English-taught Courses: A variety of English-taught courses are available. Course lists are generally released in July for Fall and January for Spring.
  • More Information: KNU – Exchange Student Program
  • 2026–2027 Fact Sheet: KNU Fact Sheet 2026–2027

                        Universidade de Sao Paulo (USP)		 學士班, 碩士班 2 2   -

秋季班: 8-12月 春季班:1-5月
https://international.umontreal.ca/fr/english/international-students/student-exchange-program/programs-of-study-with-particular-requirements/

  • 交換期間： 秋季班（巴西春季班）8 月–12 月；春季班（巴西秋季班）2 月–7 月。
  • **授課語言：**葡萄牙語為主要授課語言。
  • 葡萄牙語要求： USP 不要求提供官方語言檢定成績，但強烈建議交換生具備至少 CEFR B1 程度的葡萄牙語能力，以利修課。
  • 教育學院（FEUSP）： 接受具備基礎葡萄牙語能力 CEFR A1 的學生申請。

  • 詳細資訊： USP – International Cooperation Office
  • Exchange Period: Fall (Brazilian Spring): August–December; Spring (Brazilian Fall): February–July.
  • Language of Instruction: Portuguese is the main language of instruction at USP.
  • Portuguese Requirement: USP does not require official language test results. However, exchange students are strongly recommended to have at least CEFR B1 proficiency in Portuguese in order to attend classes.
  • Faculty of Education (FEUSP): Students with basic Portuguese proficiency at CEFR A1 are accepted.
  • English-taught Courses: Availability varies by faculty. Students should contact the relevant Local International Office for information on courses taught in English.
  • More Information:USP – International Cooperation Office

 

 
美洲 加拿大

蒙特利爾大學

Université de Montréal
                       

學士班, 碩士班, 博士班 - 2   2

秋季班: 9-1月 春季班:2-6月

  • 限交換 1 學期。
  • 授課語言： UdeM 為法語授課大學，大部分課程以法語授課；一般交換生須具備至少 CEFR B2 法語能力，部分系所要求更高。
  • 英語授課課程： 非常有限，主要集中於特定學程。English Studies 為其中之一，非英語母語者須具備至少 CEFR B2 英語能力，且部分課程限相關科系背景學生修習。
  • 特別注意： 若無法語 B2 能力，可選課程將非常有限。申請前請務必確認自己的科系背景、語言能力及預計修讀課程是否符合 UdeM 規定，請勿預設可以英語修課。
  • 法語課程： 交換生在部分情況下可修習法語課程，但不提供初級（Beginner-level）法語課程。
  • 詳細資訊： UdeM – Programs of Study with Particular Requirements
  • One-semester exchange only.
  • Language of Instruction: UdeM is a French-speaking university. Most courses are taught in French, and exchange students generally need at least CEFR B2 French proficiency. Some programmes require a higher level.
  • English-taught Courses: Very limited and mainly available in specific programmes. English Studies is one such option; non-native English speakers need at least CEFR B2 English, and some courses are restricted to students with a relevant academic background.
  • Important: Students without CEFR B2 French will have very limited course options. Before applying, please carefully check your academic background, language proficiency and intended courses. Do not assume that you can complete your exchange entirely in English.
  • More Information: UdeM – Programs of Study with Particular Requirements

 

 

 

 

 
美洲 加拿大 多倫多大學
                        University of Toronto		 學士班, 碩士班 - 2   2 秋季班: 9-1月 春季班:2-6月
https://learningabroad.utoronto.ca/inbound-visiting/inbound-exchange/english-requirements/?utm_source=chatgpt.com
  • 限交換 1 學期。
  • 申請資格： 開放學士班及碩士班學生申請。
  • 交換名額： 4 名（秋季 2 名、春季 2 名）。
  • 交換期間： 秋季班 9 月–1 月；春季班 2 月–6 月。
  • 英語要求：
    • 一般適用學院： TOEFL iBT 89（Speaking、Writing 各 22）或 IELTS Academic 6.5（各項不得低於 6.0）。TOEFL 新制 4.5（Speaking 4.0、Writing 4.5）；不接受 TOEFL Home Edition。
    • 適用：Faculty of Arts & Science、UTM、UTSC、Faculty of Kinesiology & Physical Education、Faculty of Applied Science and Engineering、Faculty of Music，以及 Faculty of Information（限大學部）。
    • Faculty of Law： TOEFL iBT 100（Reading、Writing 各 25）或 IELTS 7.0（各項不得低於 6.5）。
    • Daniels Faculty of Architecture, Landscape and Design： TOEFL iBT 100（Writing 22）或 IELTS 6.5（各項不得低於 6.0）。
    • School of Graduate Studies： TOEFL iBT 93（Writing、Speaking 各 22）或 IELTS 7.0（各項不得低於 6.5）。
    • Faculty of Information（研究所）： TOEFL iBT 107（Speaking 24、Writing 27）或 IELTS 7.5（Speaking 7.0、Writing 7.5）。
  • 詳細資訊：University of Toronto – English Language Requirements for Inbound Exchange
  • One-semester exchange only.
  • Eligibility: Open to undergraduate and Master’s students.
  • Exchange Quota: 4 students (2 for Fall and 2 for Spring).
  • Exchange Period: Fall: September–January; Spring: February–June.
  • English Requirement:
    • General Faculties: TOEFL iBT 89 (minimum 22 in Speaking and Writing) or IELTS Academic 6.5 (no band below 6.0). New TOEFL iBT scale: 4.5 (Speaking 4.0, Writing 4.5). TOEFL Home Edition is not accepted.
    • Faculty of Law: TOEFL iBT 100 (Reading and Writing 25) or IELTS 7.0 (no band below 6.5).
    • Daniels Faculty of Architecture, Landscape and Design: TOEFL iBT 100 (Writing 22) or IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0).
    • School of Graduate Studies: TOEFL iBT 93 (Writing and Speaking 22) or IELTS 7.0 (no band below 6.5).
    • Faculty of Information (Graduate Studies): TOEFL iBT 107 (Speaking 24, Writing 27) or IELTS 7.5 (Speaking 7.0, Writing 7.5).
  • More Information: University of Toronto – English Language Requirements for Inbound Exchange

美洲 美國

加州大學柏克萊分校

University of California, Berkeley
                       

碩士班 4 -   -

 

秋季班: 8-12月 春季班:1-5月

  • 僅接受碩士班學生申請。
  • 成績要求： 在學成績 GPA 達 4.00。
  • 相關費用： 須繳交簽證手續費 US$450及訪問學生費 US$500。
  • 系所限制： Physics Department、School of Law、School of Journalism 及 School of Business 等系所錄取難度較高。
  • 註冊及成績單： 交換生無法正式註冊或取得正式成績單，僅可開立上課證明；如需正式註冊及取得成績／學分，須另繳學費或學分費（每學分 US$700）。
  • 指導教授： 學生通過本校甄選後，須自行聯繫 UC Berkeley 指導教授，並取得教授同意接收後，始可進行後續交換申請。建議於校內申請前先行聯繫可能的指導教授。
  • 選填建議： 建議以工學院、電資院等相關領域碩士生為主，且建議交流期間至少 1 年。由於該校拒絕學生之比例較高，請同學選填前審慎評估。
  • Eligibility: Master’s students only.
  • GPA Requirement: Minimum GPA of 4.00.
  • Fees: A US$450 visa processing fee and a US$500 visiting student fee are required.
  • Departmental Restrictions: The Department of Physics and the Schools of Law, Journalism, and Business are among the most difficult programmes for acceptance.
  • Registration & Transcript: Exchange students cannot formally register or receive an official transcript and may only obtain a certificate of attendance. Formal registration/credits require additional tuition or credit fees (US$700 per credit).
  • Faculty Supervisor: After passing NTHU’s internal selection, students must find and obtain approval from a UC Berkeley faculty supervisor before proceeding with the exchange application. Students are strongly advised to contact potential supervisors before applying through NTHU.
  • Recommendation: This exchange is primarily recommended for Master’s students in engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, and related fields. A stay of at least one year is recommended. As the rejection rate is relatively high, students should carefully consider their suitability before selecting UC Berkeley.


 

 
美洲 美國

伊利諾大學厄巴納香檳分校

University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC)
                       

學士班, 碩士班, 博士班 - 2   -

秋季班: 8-12月 春季班:1-5月
https://studyabroad.illinois.edu/incoming-students/incoming-application-process/instructions-components/?utm_source=chatgpt.com

  • 院系限制：限申請 College of Liberal Arts and Sciences (LAS)。
  • 研究生身分：碩、博士生赴 UIUC 交換時將以大學部學生身分註冊，但可修習高年級大學部及研究所課程。
  • 建議英語能力：
    • Duolingo English Test：130
    • TOEFL iBT：90–100，且各項皆須達 20 分以上
    • IELTS：總分 7，且各項皆須達 6.5
    • 若學生在原校就讀之學位課程完全以英語授課，可由交換計畫承辦人／原校出具英語能力證明，以取代英語檢定成績。
  • 英語分級測驗： TOEFL 低於 90–100 或 IELTS 低於 7 者，抵達 UIUC 後須參加 English Placement Test；校方將依測驗結果建議學生修習適當的英語課程。
  • 選課注意事項：UIUC 無法保證學生能修習任何特定課程，交換學生應於選課時保持彈性。
  • 其他注意事項：擬申請之系所／課程可能另有額外入學條件。
  • 詳細資訊：UIUC – Information for Incoming Exchange Students
  • College Restriction: Limited to the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences (LAS), subject to the terms of the exchange agreement.
  • Graduate Students: Graduate students will be admitted to UIUC as undergraduate students, but will be able to take advanced undergraduate and graduate-level coursework at Illinois.
  • English Language Proficiency:
    • Duolingo English Test: Minimum total score of 130
    • TOEFL iBT: Minimum total score of 90–100, with 20+ in each subscore
    • IELTS: Minimum overall score of 7, with 6.5+ in each module
    • Students enrolled in a degree program taught entirely in English at their home institution may submit verification of English proficiency from their exchange coordinator or home university in lieu of test scores. Verification may be provided on university letterhead.
  • English Placement Test: Students whose TOEFL score is below 90–100 or whose IELTS score is below 7 will need to take the English Placement Test upon arrival. Based on the results, certain English language courses may be recommended.
  • Additional Requirements: The proposed program may have additional admission criteria.
  • More Information: UIUC – Information for Incoming Exchange Students

    • Pessac / Montesquieu Campus： 法律、政治學、經濟學、管理學。

    • Talence / Peixotto Campus： 理學與科技，包含生物、化學、資訊、數學、物理、地球科學及工程等。

    • Carreire / Victoire Campus： 健康科學、人文社會科學、教育、心理學、社會學等。

  • 語言要求依領域及授課語言而異：

    • Science and Technology： 法語授課須具備法語 B1；英語授課須具備英語 B1。

    • Health and Human Sciences、Education： 須具備法語 B2。

    • Economics、Management： 英語授課須具備英語 B2；若選課包含法語授課課程，須具備法語 B2。

    • Law & Political Science： 法語授課須具備法語 B1；英語授課須具備英語 B2。

    • IUT 部分課程： 行銷、運輸物流管理、企業與行政管理等課程，法語授課須具備法語 B1；英語授課須具備英語 B2。

  • 授課語言： 經濟相關課程所在的 Pessac Campus 有較多英語授課選擇；Talence 及 Carreire Campus 課程則較多以法語授課。

  • 詳細資訊： University of Bordeaux – Exchange Programmes

  • Limited to undergraduate and Master's students; doctoral students are not eligible.

  • Course Restriction: Bachelor's students are not permitted to take Master's-level courses.

  • Campus Restriction: Students must select the appropriate campus according to their intended field of study and take courses at one campus only. Courses across different campuses are not permitted.

    • Pessac / Montesquieu Campus: Law, Political Science, Economics and Management.

    • Talence / Peixotto Campus: Science and Technology, including Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Earth Sciences and Engineering.

    • Carreire / Victoire Campus: Health Sciences, Social Sciences, Education, Psychology, Sociology and related fields.

  • Language requirements vary by field and language of instruction:

    • Science and Technology: B1 French for French-taught courses and/or B1 English for English-taught courses.

    • Health and Human Sciences, Education: B2 French is required.

    • Economics and Management: B2 English for English-taught courses and/or B2 French if the learning agreement includes at least one French-taught course.

    • Law & Political Science: B1 French for French-taught courses and/or B2 English for English-taught courses.

    • Selected IUT Programmes: B1 French for French-taught courses and/or B2 English for English-taught courses, including Marketing, Transport Logistics Management, and Business and Administration Management.

  • Language of Instruction: More English-taught courses are available at the Pessac Campus, particularly in Economics, while courses at the Talence and Carreire campuses are primarily taught in French.

  • More Information: University of Bordeaux – Exchange Programmes

  • English Language Requirement: Non-native English speakers must meet the University of Liverpool’s English language requirements. Specific IELTS, TOEFL or equivalent requirements may vary depending on the programme/department.
  • Validity of English Tests: English language tests must have been taken within two years of the planned start date.
  • Exchange of Less Than Six Months: Students studying at Liverpool for less than six months may submit the University’s designated English Qualification Form as evidence of English proficiency, subject to University requirements.
  • Final-year Students: The University of Liverpool discourages students from studying at Liverpool during their final year unless they attend Semester One only, as resit examinations and the release of results may affect graduation timelines.
  • PhD Students: PhD students interested in conducting research at Liverpool may apply separately for a Visiting Postgraduate Research Student or similar research-visit scheme; this is not part of the regular taught exchange programme.
  • More Information: University of Liverpool – Entry Requirements for Visiting and Exchange Students

  • Language Requirement: At least CEFR B2 proficiency in the main language of instruction is recommended. For English, the reference requirements are IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90 or above.
  • Language of Instruction: Courses are mainly taught in German, with some courses offered in English. Availability of English-taught courses varies by faculty and semester.
  • Course Selection: Cross-faculty course booking is generally allowed; however, students should take most courses in their major and minor subject areas.
  • Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences: Cross-level course booking is not permitted.
  • English Department (English Language and Literature): Students who do not major in English Language and Literature at their home university may only take lecture courses offered by the department.
  • Department of Biology: Only students majoring in Biology, Biochemistry or Biomedicine at their home university may take courses in these fields. Block Courses are not open to exchange students.
  • Department of Psychology: Courses are open only to students who major in Psychology at their home university.
  • Faculty of Law: Students wishing to take Law courses must have completed at least four semesters at their home university before beginning their exchange at UZH.
  • More Information: University of Zurich – International Student Exchange

  • 學士班學生： 建議於秋季班交換，因秋季提供較多學士層級課程。大三學生若交換一整學年（秋＋春），可透過秋季修習特定學士課程，取得部分春季碩士課程之修課資格。
  • 碩士班學生： 建議選擇秋季班或交換一整學年，以配合課程進階順序。一般 Master-level 課程須具備相關領域之學士學位及／或至少 3 年大學學習背景，並須符合個別課程先修條件。
  • 先修要求： Faculty of Science and Engineering 強烈建議交換前至少完成 **2 年（120 ECTS）**大學課程。申請 A1N Master-level courses 時，提名／申請時至少須有 120 ECTS（抵達時約 150 ECTS）；A1F 課程則須於申請時至少 180 ECTS（抵達時約 210 ECTS）。
  • **英語要求：**Faculty of Science and Engineering 目前不要求申請時提交正式英語檢定證明，但學生須具備足以修習英語授課課程之良好英語能力。
  • 修課要求： 非歐盟學生每學期須修習至少 30 ECTS，以符合瑞典居留許可之全日制學習要求。
  • 選課注意： Faculty of Science and Engineering 沒有一般的 Add/Drop period；申請時即須選妥第一學期各 study period 的課程，校方會審查先修資格及課表衝堂。抵達後原則上僅於特殊情況允許更換課程。
  • 詳細資訊： Linköping University – Faculty of Science and Engineering Exchange Application
  • **居留許可：**瑞典居留許可及身分驗證方式請依 Swedish Migration Agency 最新規定辦理。
  • 居留許可資訊： Swedish Migration Agency – Higher Education​
  • Eligible Field: Limited to students in science and engineering-related fields. Exchange is limited to Linköping University’s Faculty of Science and Engineering.
  • Main Subject Areas: Computer Science, Information Technology, Media Technology and Visualisation; Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics and Computational Sciences; Mechanical Engineering and Design; Industrial Engineering and Logistics; Biology, Chemistry, Biotechnology and Biomedical Engineering.
  • Bachelor’s Students: An autumn exchange is strongly recommended, as more Bachelor-level courses are available during the autumn semester. Third-year students staying for a full academic year may become eligible for certain Master-level courses in the spring after completing appropriate Bachelor-level courses in the autumn.
  • Master’s Students: An autumn semester or a full academic year is recommended to benefit from course progression. Master-level courses generally require relevant prior university studies and specific prerequisites.
  • Academic Prerequisites: At least two years (120 ECTS) of prior university study is strongly recommended. Specific Master-level courses have additional ECTS and prerequisite requirements.
  • English Language Requirement: The Faculty of Science and Engineering does not currently require an English language certificate with the application. However, students must have a good command of English sufficient to follow their courses.
  • Course Load: Non-EU students must study at least 30 ECTS per semester to meet the full-time study requirement for a Swedish residence permit.
  • Course Changes: There is no regular add/drop period at the Faculty of Science and Engineering. Course selections are reviewed before admission, and changes after arrival are normally approved only in exceptional circumstances.
  • Exchange Duration: Exchange may be for one semester or a full academic year, subject to the applicable NTHU–LiU exchange agreement.
  • More Information: Linköping University – Faculty of Science and Engineering
  • Residence Permit: For residence permit applications and identity/passport verification procedures, please refer to the latest requirements of the Swedish Migration Agency.
  • Residence Permit Information: Swedish Migration Agency – Higher Education

  • 特殊語言要求－Faculty of Language, Literature and Humanities / Department of English and American Studies：

  • 開放領域： 原則上多數學科領域皆開放交換生，但 Medicine、M.A. Global History、M.A. Global Studies 不開放；Law 及 M.A. Mind and Brain 另可能有申請／選課限制。實際仍須依HU Berlin各系所最新規定辦理。
  • 課程查詢： 請使用 HU Berlin AGNES Online Course Catalogue 查詢最新課程。
  • **簽證提醒：**德國學生簽證（包含交換學生）目前透過 Auslandsportal 線上簽證系統提出申請。建議同學取得交換資格後儘早確認最新簽證規定並準備文件；完成線上文件預審後，系統將提供簽證預約連結，再依通知至德國在台協會辦理生物特徵資料及相關程序。
  • 詳細資訊： Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin
  • 課程查詢： HU Berlin – AGNES Course Catalogue

  • Course Selection: Undergraduate exchange students may generally take courses from a maximum of two departments, while graduate exchange students normally select courses from one department.
  • Special Language Requirements – Faculty of Language, Literature and Humanities / Department of English and American Studies:
    • Undergraduate students: minimum CEFR B2 English.
    • Graduate students: minimum CEFR C1 English.
  • School of Business and Economics: Master's programmes are taught in English, and courses have a strong quantitative and mathematical focus. A strong background in Mathematics is therefore essential. For 2026/27, Bachelor-level exchange students require German B2 or English C1, while Master-level exchange students require English C1.
  • Available Disciplines: Most disciplines are available to exchange students, except Medicine, M.A. Global History and M.A. Global Studies. Further restrictions may apply to Law and M.A. Mind and Brain. Availability remains subject to the latest departmental requirements.
  • Course Catalogue: Students should use the AGNES Online Course Catalogue to check current course offerings.
  • Visa Reminder: Student visa applications, including those for exchange students, are currently submitted through Germany's Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the latest visa requirements and prepare the required documents as early as possible. After the online document review has been completed, applicants will receive a link to arrange an appointment for biometrics and the remaining procedures.

  • 德語課程： 校方為交換生提供多種 German as a Foreign Language 課程，包括學期前密集課程及學期間課程。

  • 課程資訊： University of Tübingen – Courses for Exchange Students

  • Exchange is limited to one semester only.
  • Open to undergraduate and Master's students only; PhD students are not eligible to apply.
  • Language of Instruction: The main language of instruction is German, although an increasing number of courses are offered in English. Students should check the latest list of English-taught courses for each semester.
     
  • Language Requirements: Students are recommended to have at least CEFR B2 proficiency in the language of instruction (German or English). A completed CEFR B1 level is the minimum requirement for admission. Official proof of language proficiency is not generally required, except for certain subject areas.
  • Special Language Requirements:
    • Law (all study levels), Biochemistry / Chemistry (B.Sc.): Proof of German proficiency at completed B1 or currently studying at B2 level is required.
    • Biology / Molecular Medicine / Pharmacy (B.Sc.): Students from overseas partner universities must provide proof of German proficiency at completed B1 or currently studying at B2 level.
    • Human Medicine: Appropriate proof of German proficiency is required; no English-taught courses are available in this field.
  • Course Restrictions: Biology is available to overseas exchange students only if Biology or a closely related field is their major at their home university. Pharmacy is available only to students majoring in Pharmacy. Human Medicine requires a specific exchange agreement between the respective Faculties of Medicine.
  • Economics: Overseas students wishing to study exclusively in English in the Bachelor’s programme in Economics & Business Administration must have completed at least two courses in Mathematics/Statistics/Econometrics and two courses in Business Studies/Economics.
  • Course Load: A workload of no more than 30 ECTS per semester is recommended.
  • Residence/Visa: Student visa applications are currently submitted primarily through Germany’s Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the latest visa requirements and prepare their documents as early as possible.
  • More Information: University of Tübingen – Application and Preparation

 

 

 

 

 
歐洲 德國 萊布尼茲光子技術研究所
Leibniz Institute of Photonic Technology (Leibniz IPHT)		 學士班, 碩士班, 博士班 1 - -  

秋季班：10-3月春季班：4月-9月

  • **限理學院、工學院及電機資訊學院之大學部及研究生申請。
  • 機構性質： Leibniz IPHT 位於德國耶拿（Jena），為非大學型研究機構（non-university research institute），是 Leibniz Association 成員，並與 Friedrich Schiller University Jena 維持密切的學術研究合作。
  • 研究特色： 主要從事**光子技術（Photonics）及光學健康科技（Optical Health Technologies）**相關研究，結合物理、化學、生物醫學、工程、資料科學及人工智慧等跨領域技術，應用於健康與醫療、安全、環境及能源等領域。
  • 主要研究領域： 包括 Biomedical Microscopy and Imaging、Multiscale Spectroscopy、Ultrasensitive Detection、Specialty Fiber Optics、Nanoplasmonics，以及 Bioanalytical and Biomedical Chip Systems。
  • 學生研修方式： Leibniz IPHT 並非一般授課型大學，學生主要透過專業實習、研究計畫及學位論文研究等方式參與研究。
  • 學生研究機會： 可進行與學業相關之專業實習，亦可於 Leibniz IPHT 進行 undergraduate thesis、Bachelor’s thesis 或 Master’s thesis 相關研究。相關領域包括 Laser and Optotechnologies、Precision Engineering、Materials Engineering、Biotechnology、Photovoltaics and Semiconductor Technologies、Physical Engineering 及 Computer Engineering 等。
  • **注意事項：**Leibniz IPHT 為研究機構而非一般大學，因此學生之申請資格、研修期間、研究內容及相關要求，應依本校與 Leibniz IPHT 之合作協議及接收研究團隊之最新規定辦理。
  • **簽證提醒：**德國學生簽證目前主要透過 Auslandsportal 線上簽證系統提出申請。建議同學取得研修資格後儘早確認適用之簽證類別及最新申請規定，並準備相關文件。
  • 官方網站： Leibniz Institute of Photonic Technology (Leibniz IPHT)
  • 學生實習及論文研究： Leibniz IPHT – University Students / Theses
  • Eligible NTHU Students: Open to undergraduate and graduate students from the College of Science, College of Engineering, and College of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science.
  • Institution Type: Leibniz IPHT is a non-university research institute located in Jena, Germany. It is a member of the Leibniz Association and maintains close academic and research cooperation with Friedrich Schiller University Jena.
  • Research Focus: Leibniz IPHT specialises in photonics and optical health technologies, combining physics, chemistry, biomedical sciences, engineering, data science and artificial intelligence to develop light-based solutions for health and medicine, safety, the environment and energy.
  • Major Research Areas: Research areas include Biomedical Microscopy and Imaging, Multiscale Spectroscopy, Ultrasensitive Detection, Specialty Fiber Optics, Nanoplasmonics, and Bioanalytical and Biomedical Chip Systems.
  • Study/Research Format: As Leibniz IPHT is a research institute rather than a conventional teaching university, students generally participate through research projects, internships and thesis research rather than regular university coursework.
  • Research Opportunities: Students may undertake study-related internships and research for undergraduate, Bachelor’s or Master’s theses. Relevant fields include Laser and Optotechnologies, Precision Engineering, Materials Engineering, Biotechnology, Photovoltaics and Semiconductor Technologies, Physical Engineering, and Computer Engineering.
  • Important: As Leibniz IPHT is a research institute rather than a conventional university, eligibility, duration of stay, research activities and other requirements are subject to the applicable cooperation agreement with NTHU and the latest requirements of the host research group.
  • Visa Reminder: German student visa applications are currently submitted primarily through the Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the applicable visa category and the latest requirements and prepare the necessary documents as early as possible after confirming their research placement.
  • Official Website: Leibniz Institute of Photonic Technology (Leibniz IPHT)

  • 授課語言： KIT 課程以德語及英語授課；各學院英語授課課程數量不同，學生應於選填前確認欲修課程之授課語言及相關先修條件。
  • 一般語言要求：
    • 僅修習德語授課課程：須具備至少 CEFR B1 德語能力。
    • 僅修習英語授課課程：須具備至少 CEFR B2 英語能力。
    • 同時修習德語及英語授課課程：須同時具備 德語 B1 + 英語 B2。
  • 特殊學院語言要求：
    • Chemistry（CHEM）： 修習 Chemistry 課程須具備 CEFR C1 德語能力。
    • Humanities and Social Sciences（GEIST-SOZ）： 德語 A2/B1 為必要條件；若修習英語授課課程，另須具備 英語 B2。
    • 其他多數學院，包括 Architecture、Civil Engineering, Geo and Environmental Sciences、Chemical and Process Engineering、Electrical Engineering and Information Technology、Informatics、Mechanical Engineering、Physics 及 Economics and Management，原則上依上述 德語 B1／英語 B2 規定辦理。
  • 語言證明： 語言證明於申請截止日須為最近 5 年內核發。Overseas Exchange 申請者之語言檢定須涵蓋 reading、writing、listening、speaking 四項能力；單純線上分級測驗、僅有出席紀錄之語言課程證明，或未載明語言程度之證明不予接受。
  • 德語課程： KIT 強烈建議德語能力不足的交換生參加學期前德語課程（pre-semester German course），以利在德國生活及學習。
  • 注意事項： 各學院可能另訂較高或不同之語言及選課要求，學生應於申請前查閱欲申請學院之最新規定；實際要求以 KIT 申請年度最新公告為準。
  • **簽證提醒：**德國學生簽證（包含交換學生）目前透過 Auslandsportal 線上簽證系統提出申請。建議同學取得交換資格後，儘早確認適用之簽證類別及最新申請規定，並準備相關文件。簽證申請方式及所需文件請以德國在台協會最新公告為準。
  • 詳細資訊： Karlsruhe Institute of Technology – Overseas Exchange Requirements
  • 各學院語言要求：KIT – Language Requirements
  • 德國學生簽證： 德國在台協會－學生簽證
  • [Fall 2027 / Spring 2028] Exchange is limited to the Fall Semester only (one semester).
    • Open to undergraduate and Master’s students only; PhD students are not eligible to apply.
  • Language of Instruction: Courses at KIT are taught in German and English. The availability of English-taught courses varies by department. Students should check the language of instruction and prerequisites of their intended courses before applying.
  • General Language Requirements:
    • German-taught courses only: Minimum CEFR B1 German.
    • English-taught courses only: Minimum CEFR B2 English.
    • Courses taught in both German and English: Both German B1 and English B2 are required.
  • Special Departmental Language Requirements:
    • Chemistry (CHEM): CEFR C1 German is required for Chemistry courses.
    • Humanities and Social Sciences (GEIST-SOZ): German A2/B1 is mandatory; students taking English-taught courses must additionally provide proof of English B2.
    • Most other departments, including Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geo and Environmental Sciences, Chemical and Process Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology, Informatics, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, and Economics and Management, generally follow the German B1 / English B2 requirements above.
  • Language Certificates: Language certificates must have been issued within the five years preceding the application deadline. For Overseas Exchange applicants, the certificate must cover all four language skills: reading, writing, listening and speaking. Online placement tests, certificates of attendance, and certificates without a stated language level are not accepted.
  • German Language Course: Students with insufficient German proficiency are strongly encouraged to participate in the pre-semester German course offered by KIT.
  • Important: Language and course requirements may vary by department. Students should carefully check the latest requirements of their intended KIT department before applying. The latest requirements published by KIT for the relevant application year shall prevail.
  • Visa Reminder: Student visa applications for Germany, including those for exchange students, are currently submitted through the Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the applicable visa category and the latest requirements and prepare the required documents as early as possible after confirming their exchange.
  • More Information: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology – Overseas Exchange Requirements
  • Departmental Language Requirements: KIT – Language Requirements

  • 限學士班及碩士班學生申請，不開放博士班學生申請。
  • 授課語言： 課程主要以德語授課，另有部分英語授課課程。尤其學士班的英語授課課程數量較少；學生選填前應確認當學期實際開課情形。
  • 修習英語授課課程： 須具備至少 CEFR B2 英語能力，並於申請時提供預計修習之課程清單（list of planned courses）。德語密集課程為建議參加，但非強制。
  • 修習德語授課課程：
    • 德語 C1：密集德語課程為選修。
    • 德語 B1 或 B2：密集德語課程為選修。
    • 德語 A2 + 英語 B2：必須參加密集德語課程。
  • 語言證明： 須提供符合 **CEFR（A1–C2）**程度標示之德語或英語能力證明。原校開立之個人語言能力證明原則上亦可接受；若文件並非德文或英文，須由正式翻譯人員或原校提供翻譯。
  • **英語授課注意事項：**學士班英語授課課程數量較少；交換生可依資格修習部分英語授課之 MSc 課程，因此選填前務必確認課程層級、先修條件及當學期是否開課。
  • 密集德語課程： Intensive German Course 約於正式授課開始前 1 個月舉行，課程費用目前為 €250；符合出席及考試要求者可取得 6 ECTS。
  • **簽證提醒：**德國學生簽證（包含交換學生）目前透過 Auslandsportal 線上簽證系統提出申請。建議同學取得交換資格後，儘早確認適用之簽證類別及最新申請規定，並準備相關文件。簽證申請方式及所需文件請以德國在台協會最新公告為準。
  • 詳細資訊： University of Stuttgart – Overseas Exchange Program
  • 語言及申請資訊： University of Stuttgart – Overseas Exchange FAQ
  • 德國學生簽證： 德國在台協會－學生簽證
  • Open to undergraduate and Master’s students only; PhD students are not eligible to apply.
  • Language of Instruction: Courses are primarily taught in German, although some courses are available in English. The number of English-taught courses is particularly limited at the Bachelor’s level.
  • English-taught Courses: Students planning to study exclusively in English must have at least CEFR B2 English proficiency and submit a list of planned courses with their application. Participation in the Intensive German Course is recommended but not compulsory.
  • German-taught Courses:
    • German C1: Participation in the Intensive German Course is optional.
    • German B1 or B2: Participation in the Intensive German Course is optional.
    • German A2 + English B2: Participation in the Intensive German Course is compulsory.
  • Language Certificates: Proof of German or English proficiency must clearly indicate the corresponding CEFR level (A1–C2). Individual language certificates issued by the home university are generally accepted. Documents not issued in German or English must be accompanied by an appropriate translation.
  • English-taught Courses: Only a limited number of Bachelor-level courses are taught in English. Exchange students may be able to take English-taught MSc courses subject to the relevant academic prerequisites and course availability.
  • Intensive German Course: The course generally starts approximately one month before the lecture period. The current course fee is €250, and students who meet the attendance requirements and pass the final examination may receive 6 ECTS credits.
  • Visa Reminder: Student visa applications for Germany, including those for exchange students, are currently submitted through the Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the applicable visa category and latest requirements and prepare the required documents as early as possible after confirming their exchange.
  • More Information: University of Stuttgart – Overseas Exchange Program
  • Visa Information: German Institute Taipei – Student Visa

  • 限學士班及碩士班學生申請，不開放博士班學生申請。
  • 授課語言： TUHH 提供德語及英語授課課程，學生應於申請前確認欲修習課程之授課語言、課程層級及先修要求。
  • 語言證明： 交換生申請文件包含 Language Certificate，學生須依 TUHH 要求提供相應語言能力證明。
  • 德語課程： TUHH 於冬季學期開始前為交換生提供約 2 週的密集德語課程，合作學校交換生可免費參加，完成後可取得 4 ECTS。須注意此課程不能作為交換申請所需 B1 德語能力之證明。夏季學期開始前目前沒有提供此密集課程。
  • 一般德語課程： 交換生於學期間亦可修習 TUHH 與 VHS 合作提供的 German as a Foreign Language 課程。
  • 註冊及學期費： 交換生抵達 TUHH 後須完成註冊並繳納 semester fee；該費用包含學生相關服務及大眾運輸學期票等。實際金額請依交換當學期最新公告為準。
  • 健康保險： 辦理 TUHH 入學註冊時須提供符合德國規定之有效健康保險證明；一般旅遊醫療保險不能取代學生健康保險。
  • 注意事項： TUHH 的考試期間可能延續至學期末，因此學生在購買返臺機票前，應先確認所選課程之考試日期及方式。
  • **簽證提醒：**德國學生簽證（包含交換學生）目前透過 Auslandsportal 線上簽證系統提出申請。建議同學取得交換資格後，儘早確認適用之簽證類別及最新申請規定，並準備相關文件。簽證申請方式及所需文件請以德國在台協會最新公告為準。
  • 交換生資訊： TU Hamburg – Exchange Students
  • 申請資訊：TU Hamburg – Exchange Student Application Procedure
  • 德國學生簽證： 德國在台協會－Auslandsportal 線上簽證系統
  • Open to undergraduate and Master’s students only; PhD students are not eligible to apply.
  • Language of Instruction: Courses are offered in German and English. Students should check the language of instruction, course level and prerequisites of their intended courses before applying.
  • Language Certificate: Exchange students are required to submit a Language Certificate as part of their exchange application.
  • German Language Course: TUHH offers an approximately two-week Intensive German Language Course before the Winter Semester. The course is free of charge for exchange students from partner institutions and may be worth 4 ECTS. Please note that participation in this course cannot be used as proof of the B1 German proficiency required for admission to exchange studies. The intensive course is currently not offered before the Summer Semester.
  • Regular German Courses: Exchange students may also take German as a Foreign Language courses during the semester.
  • Enrolment and Semester Fee: Exchange students must complete enrolment after arrival and pay the applicable semester fee, which covers student services and the public transport semester ticket, among other benefits.
  • Health Insurance: Students must provide proof of valid health insurance that meets German requirements when enrolling at TUHH. Travel health insurance is not accepted as a substitute for student health insurance.
  • Important: Examination periods may extend well beyond the lecture period. Students should check their examination dates before booking their return flights.
  • Visa Reminder: Student visa applications for Germany, including those for exchange students, are currently submitted through the Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the applicable visa category and the latest requirements and prepare the required documents as early as possible after confirming their exchange. Visa procedures and required documents are subject to the latest information provided by the German Institute Taipei.
  • More Information: TU Hamburg – Exchange Students
  • Application Procedure: TU Hamburg – Exchange Student Application Procedure

Technical University of Darmstadt (TU Darmstadt)
                       

學士班, 碩士班 2 － －  

秋季班：１０－３月春季班：４月-９月
https://www.tu-darmstadt.de/studieren/studieninteressierte/internationale_studieninteressierte/austauschprogramme_inbound/index.en.jsp?utm_source=chatgpt.com

  • 限理學院及工學院之學士班及碩士班學生申請，不開放博士班學生申請。
  • 授課語言： TU Darmstadt 主要授課語言為德語，但高年級學士班及碩士班有愈來愈多英語授課課程。
  • 語言要求：
    • 修習英語授課課程：須具備至少 CEFR B2 英語能力。
    • 修習德語授課課程：須具備至少 CEFR B2 德語能力。
    • 即使完全修習英語授課課程，校方仍建議至少具備 A1–A2 基礎德語能力，以利在德國日常生活。
  • 語言證明： 可接受正式語言檢定或其他可證明語言程度之文件，例如 TOEFL、IELTS、Cambridge、原校語言教師證明或成績單等；校方建議證明文件以兩年內為佳。若學生為英語母語者、目前以英語修讀學位，或就讀於英語授課大學，英語證明可免附。
  • 德語課程： 校方提供交換生免費的學期前密集德語課程，通常於 3 月或 9 月舉行；即使主要修習英語課程，亦建議參加，以提升在德國學習及生活所需的德語能力。
  • 修課學分： TU Darmstadt 採用 ECTS 制度，標準修課量為每學期約 30 ECTS，一學年約 60 ECTS。
  • 學期費用： 交換生仍須繳交 semester fee；金額每學期調整，請依 TU Darmstadt 當學期最新公告為準。
  • **簽證提醒：**德國學生簽證（包含交換學生）目前透過 Auslandsportal 線上簽證系統提出申請。建議同學取得交換資格後，儘早確認適用之簽證類別及最新申請規定，並準備相關文件。簽證申請方式及所需文件請以德國在台協會最新公告為準。
  • 詳細資訊： TU Darmstadt – Exchange Programmes for Incoming Students
  • 學期日期： TU Darmstadt – Semester Dates
  • 德國學生簽證： 德國在台協會－學生簽證
  • Fact Sheet： TU Darmstadt – Fact Sheet
  • Open to undergraduate and master’s students from the College of Science and the College of Engineering only. Doctoral students are not eligible to apply.
  • Language of Instruction: The main language of instruction at TU Darmstadt is German, although a growing number of courses for advanced Bachelor’s and Master’s students are offered in English.
  • Language Requirements for Students from Non-European Partner Universities:
    • English-taught courses: Minimum CEFR B2 English.
    • German-taught courses: Minimum CEFR B2 German.
    • Even when studying entirely in English, students are strongly encouraged to have at least basic German (A1–A2) for everyday life in Germany.
  • Proof of Language Proficiency: Accepted proof may include TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge certificates, a letter from a language instructor at the home university, or a transcript of records demonstrating the required level. Proof should ideally be no more than two years old. English native speakers and students studying in English or at an English-language institution generally do not need to provide proof of English proficiency.
  • German Language Courses: TU Darmstadt offers free intensive German language courses before the beginning of the semester, usually in March or September. Participation is recommended even for students planning to study primarily in English.
  • Course Load: TU Darmstadt uses the ECTS system. A standard workload is approximately 30 ECTS per semester / 60 ECTS per academic year.
  • Semester Fee: Exchange students are required to pay the applicable semester fee, which is adjusted each semester.
  • Visa Reminder: Student visa applications for Germany, including those for exchange students, are currently submitted through the Consular Services Portal (Auslandsportal). Students are advised to check the applicable visa category and the latest requirements and prepare the required documents as early as possible after confirming their exchange.
  • More Information: TU Darmstadt – Exchange Programmes for Incoming Students
  • Semester Dates: TU Darmstadt – Semester Dates
  • Fact Sheet： TU Darmstadt – Fact Sheet

https://www.ucy.ac.cy/ir/mobility/erasmus/studies-incoming-er/2025-2026/?lang=en

  • [2027秋／2028春] 限交換秋季 1 學期。
  • 限學士班及碩士班學生申請，不開放博士班學生申請。
  • 授課語言： UCY 主要授課語言為希臘語（Greek），部分系所提供英語授課課程；French and European Studies 亦提供法語及德語課程。若部分系所沒有英語授課課程，在授課教師同意的情況下，部分希臘語課程可為交換生提供英文教材、作業、輔導及考試。
  • 英語要求： 須具備至少 CEFR B2 英語能力，並提供正式語言能力證明。
  • 可接受之英語證明： 包括 TOEFL、IELTS、TOEIC、Cambridge、IGCSE、ESOL、Oxford Test of English、DAAD 或其他國際認可且達 CEFR B2 以上之英語能力證明。
  • 希臘語能力： 校方建議交換生至少具備基本希臘語能力，並強烈建議參加 School of Modern Greek 所提供之希臘語課程。交換生可免費修習相關希臘語課程。
  • GPA： 一般交換生建議 GPA 至少達 6/10；申請 Department of Computer Science 者須達 6.5/10。
  • 修課量： 交換生每學期一般修課量約為 30 ECTS。
  • 注意事項： 各系所英語授課課程數量不同，其中 School of Economics 提供較多英語授課課程；其他多數系所的英語授課課程較少。學生選填前應先確認當年度實際開設課程及授課語言。
  • 詳細資訊： University of Cyprus – Incoming Exchange Students 2026–2027
  • 簽證／入境許可資訊： University of Cyprus – Entry Permit for Non-EU Exchange Students
  • [Fall 2027 / Spring 2028] Exchange is limited to the Fall Semester only (one semester).
  • Open to undergraduate and Master's students only; PhD students are not eligible to apply.
  • Language of Instruction: The main language of instruction at UCY is Greek, although some departments offer courses in English. The Department of French and European Studies also offers courses in French and German. In departments where English-taught courses are not available, certain Greek-taught courses may provide bibliography, assignments, tutorials, and examinations in English, subject to the instructor's approval.
  • English Requirement: Students are required to have at least CEFR B2 English proficiency and submit an official language certificate.
  • Accepted English Certificates: Accepted certificates include TOEFL, IELTS, TOEIC, Cambridge, IGCSE, ESOL, Oxford Test of English, DAAD, or another internationally recognised English language certificate corresponding to CEFR B2 or higher.
  • Greek Language: Students are advised to have at least basic knowledge of Greek and are strongly encouraged to attend Greek language courses offered by the School of Modern Greek. Greek language courses are available free of charge to exchange students.
  • GPA: A GPA of at least 6/10 is generally expected. Students nominated to the Department of Computer Science must have a GPA of at least 6.5/10.
  • Course Load: The average workload for exchange students is 30 ECTS per semester.
  • Important: The availability of English-taught courses varies considerably by department. The School of Economics currently offers a relatively large number of courses in English, while most other departments offer only a limited number. Students should carefully check the courses and languages of instruction available for the relevant academic year before applying.
  • More Information: University of Cyprus – Incoming Exchange Students 2026–2027
  • Visa / Entry Permit Information: University of Cyprus – Entry Permit for Non-EU Exchange Students

  • 詳細資訊： TU Dresden – Exchange Students
  • Fact Sheet：TU Dresden Exchange / Erasmus Fact Sheet 2027/28
  • Exchange Period: Winter Semester: October–March; Summer Semester: April–September.
  • Open to undergraduate and master's students only; doctoral students are not eligible to apply.
  • Language Requirement: Courses are mainly taught in German, with English-taught courses also available in certain programmes. Students should check the specific language requirements of their intended faculty/programme. For Erasmus+ worldwide mobility, TU Dresden currently specifies German B1 or English B1/B2 for English-taught courses.
